“Indian media sensationalizing Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is irresponsible. HMPV is a known virus causing mild cold-like symptoms in most cases. 
Stop fear-mongering for clicks and TRPs. Public health deserves facts, not panic. #hmpvvirus
